svg.title: SintBot — the group-project AI daemon, running on your own machine
svg.desc: Animated banner. Left: the SintBot wordmark and tagline. Right: a card in the Slack channel #design-review — Mei asks to redo the homepage in the tech-dark style; SintBot works through reading the style file, generating two versions and a pre-delivery check, then reports Delivered with an Open preview button.
